> ⚠️ **This is a beta.** Every change passes the automated tests on Linux, macOS, Windows and Android, but this build hasn't been tested on real devices yet. Want the proven version? Stay on [v0.7.0](https://github.com/flowerpower584/fluxsync/releases/tag/v0.7.0). Found something odd? [Tell us](https://github.com/flowerpower584/fluxsync/issues/new).

**FluxSync copies on one device and pastes on another — over your own Wi-Fi, end-to-end encrypted, no account, no cloud.**

This beta finishes what [v0.8.0-beta.2](https://github.com/flowerpower584/fluxsync/releases/tag/v0.8.0-beta.2) started (files, Android send buttons, private passwords, history retention, delivery marks). New here:

## What's new
- **Files travel through your other devices too.** If your laptop and desktop are each paired with your phone but not with each other, a file copied on the laptop now reaches the desktop through the phone, as text and images already did. A device on an older version is simply skipped.
- **Fixed:** a very small file (under about 1 KB) could be passed on to a device on an older version that can't read files.
- **"Show in folder"** next to a received file in the desktop history opens Downloads/FluxSync.
- **Passwords on Linux X11** are now recognized too: a copy from KeePassXC (or any password manager that marks its copies) syncs as a secret — never kept in history, wiped after a minute.

## Download

| Device | File to download |
|---|---|
| **Android** (phone or tablet) | `FluxSync-v0.8.0-beta.3-arm64-v8a.apk` |
| **Mac with Apple chip** (M1, M2, M3…) | the `.zip` ending in `_aarch64.zip` |
| **Mac with Intel chip** | the `.zip` ending in `_x64.zip` |
| **Windows** (most PCs) | the file ending in `_x64-setup.exe` |
| **Windows on ARM** | the file ending in `_arm64-setup.exe` |
| **Linux** (Ubuntu, Debian…) | the `.deb` file |
| **Linux** (any distribution) | the `.AppImage` file |

The [README](https://github.com/flowerpower584/fluxsync#readme) walks through installing and pairing, step by step.

**Upgrading:** install over your current version; pairings and history are kept.
